scope: Retrospective exploratory forecasting of within-country ladder changes. Automated-agent research, not independent human/domain-expert review. Known published aggregate error is prior information, so this is not blinded validation.

background.inequality: Frozen latest 2010–2015 SI.POV.GINI divided by 100. Missing/invalid fold feature uses median fitted on fold training transition rows. If entire column missing, fallback 0.5. No new sources.
background.inactive: Population does not weight fitting or scoring; all AI/transfers/policy channels absent.

outcomes.wellbeing: WHR Cantril ladder, 0–10, pinned retrospective panel; first differences between adjacent observed calendar years only
outcomes.gdp: World Bank GDP per person, constant-2015 USD; log differences between adjacent observed calendar years only

fit.equation: For adjacent paired observations (i,t-1),(i,t): y=L_it-L_i,t-1; x=[log(G_it/G_i,t-1),log(G_i,t-1),governance_i,gini_i/100]. z_j=(x_j-mu_j)/s_j. b=argmin_b mean((y-[1,z]b)^2)+lambda*sum_j(b_j^2), including penalized intercept. Solve (Z^T Z/n + lambda I)b=Z^T y/n. No country intercept, lagged ladder regressor, anchor, interaction, polynomial, spline or nonlinear alternative.
fittedQuantities: training-only feature medians, population means and population standard deviations
pooled historical annual log GDP growth and each country count/mean
ridge penalty selected by internal temporal validation
fit.standardization: Use transition training rows only, after median fill; population SD sqrt(mean squared deviation), replacing SD < 1e-12 with 1. No target standardization. GDP/log GDP are required for training rows and never imputed.
fit.trainingRows: All 101 eligible background countries; form only adjacent-year complete ladder/GDP transitions with endpoints within current training years. No restriction by eventual 2018 origin membership; no gap bridging. Each transition equal weight.
fit.emptyFallback: If no valid ladder transition, zero all ladder coefficients and use neutral normalizer; if no GDP transitions anywhere, pooled GDP log growth = 0. No country discarded for missing prior transitions.

gdpForecast.equation: For each fit origin T, take only adjacent valid GDP pairs in 2015..T. Let n_i and m_i be country count and mean annual log changes, and m_pool the pooled transition mean. r_i=(n_i*m_i+2*m_pool)/(n_i+2). If n_i=0 use m_pool. Clamp r_i to [-0.1,0.1]. Forecast G_i,T+h=G_i,T*exp(h*r_i).
gdpForecast.selection: No GDP hyperparameter search; shrinkage and clamp are fixed before trial. GDP independently fits historical GDP, not ladder. Training-time current GDP growth may explain past ladder change, but all forecast-time GDP growth comes from the separate past-only model. Internal validation targets never become forecast inputs.

forecast.equation: For h=1..7, x_h=[r_i,log(G_i,T)+(h-1)*r_i,governance_i,gini_i/100]; d_h=[1,standardize(x_h)]b; Lhat_i,T+h=clamp(Lhat_i,T+h-1+d_h,0,10), starting Lhat_i,T=L_i,T. Static governance and inequality stay frozen; predicted start income updates annually. No future actual GDP, ladder or feature enters recurrence.
reportCounts: GDP growth clamps below/above bound by fit and country
ladder lower/upper clamps by fold/candidate/horizon/country and final forecast

internalValidation.foldCohort: All background-eligible training countries with valid paired origin outcomes at that fold origin. No later origin membership or validation availability conditions; score observed targets separately with identical persistence masks. Missing origin country listed, never future-filled.
internalValidation.selectionMetric: Pooled ladder MAE over all observed country/fold/horizon validation predictions. Each scored row equal weight, including the two distinct origin forecasts of 2018. This is tuning evidence, not unbiased performance after selection.
internalValidation.selectionRule: Choose minimum pooled ladder MAE; absolute ties within 1e-12 choose largest lambda (most shrinkage). If no scored rows choose lambda=100. No adaptive grid expansion or secondary selection.
metrics: pooled, fold and horizon ladder MAE/RMSE/bias and persistence with paired masks
pooled, fold and horizon GDP cumulative growth percentage-point MAE/RMSE/bias and persistence, 100*(predictedGDP-actualGDP)/originGDP
coverage, missing targets, country GDP fallback and clamp counts
internalValidation.normalizationBoundary: Recompute median, mean, SD, regressions, GDP growth and fallbacks within each fold training section. Predictions produced before and independently of validation scoring. Never use realized validation GDP for ladder predictions.
internalValidation.limitations: Only two forecast origins, with one-year and two-year horizons and repeated countries. This cannot establish seven-year stability or independent-country skill. The same folds select the penalty and summarize candidate errors.

exclusions.reason: Missing historical population, gini, ge, rl, cc

cohort.rule: Exact original frozen origin cohort; no future-availability or outcome-based deletion. No additional exclusion or source extension.

groups.incomeQuartiles: Sort original 2018 origin countries by GDP ascending then id; group=floor(index*4/100), 0..3. Frozen for all horizons.

baseline: Country outcome persistence from 2018, on exactly matched score masks and horizons.
primaryMetric: 2025 endpoint ladder MAE and model-minus-persistence difference, unweighted across observed countries.
secondaryMetrics: ladder MAE/RMSE/bias at every horizon and by frozen origin income quartile
coverage counts and reasons for missing targets, exclusions, clamped outputs
emptyOrUndefinedMetrics: null plus reason, never zero success
priorKnownResult: Published 0.3175 versus 0.2897 concerns pooled country-year MAE, not 2025 endpoint. Not used for numeric fitting or selection.
integrityGates: protocol commit precedes any fit/internal validation
only train.json and origin.json numerical reads
all 700 outputs finite; GDP positive; ladder within 0–10
mutating validation GDP or ladder cannot change predictions from earlier origin
no future observation in normalizer, imputer, GDP fit or fallback
no full repository check until controller releases external gate
freeze all five and long-run proxy before controller scores once per entry
publish all results without post-score refit
vintageLimit: Observation years are historical but sources were retrieved later. Revisions and publication delays remain; this is not an archived 2018 information set. All proposed design choices were made after test years existed.
prohibited: reading external test outcomes or other methods outputs before collective freeze
using validation-year GDP as ladder forecast covariate
fitting by observed post-2018 country values or borrowed literature coefficients
changing cohort, horizon, grid or model after external scoring

references.title: Hoerl and Kennard (1970), Ridge Regression: Biased Estimation for Nonorthogonal Problems
references.use: Quadratic coefficient penalty trades bias for lower coefficient variance; no performance guarantee or coefficient borrowed.

references.title: Hyndman and Athanasopoulos, Forecasting: Principles and Practice, 5.10
references.use: Training precedes validation origin, including multistep forecasts.

references.title: Stevenson and Wolfers (2008), Economic Growth and Subjective Well-Being
references.use: Motivation for testing within-country changes and log income; association is not evidence of held-out forecast skill. No numerical coefficients borrowed.
